Mira (CSM): SkylineCo (acct: sky-900) flagged: trial day 9, only sandbox pinged. health slipped to 43. want to try a compact 'escape-hatch' play before trial ends. :lifesaver:
RevBot: Rule fired 'trial_plateau' -> health 71 -> 43 at 1788881234.
Mira (CSM): Escape-hatch idea (short + customer-friendly): 1) 30m hands-on pairing to run the first inference + index 2) $199 onboarding credit 3) 'Hatch' downgrade offer if still blocked (clear, opt-in only) 4) 3-question feedback capture.
Cal (AM): I like the opt-in downgrade language. we should make it explicit: "No surprise charges; choose Pause or Starter-Hatch within 14 days."
Jae (Enablement): I can run the 30m. Agenda: 5m goals, 15m live run, 7m troubleshoot, 3m next steps. I'll prepare a 90s async clip as backup.
Rory (Support): I'll open ticket SUP-9900 and add recent logs. request staging keys only during pairing. also will check SDK version compatibility.
Ezra (CS Ops): $199 credit approved. file CSOPS ticket once session done. include non-refundable clause unless platform outage.
Mira (CSM): Draft customer message going out now: "We noticed your integration stalled — can we book a 30m pairing? we'll include a small credit and a clear escape-hatch option if you'd prefer a pause instead of immediate billing."
SkylineCo: Quick Q — what exactly is the escape-hatch? we don't want data lost if we pause.
Mira (CSM): Escape-hatch = opt-in Pause for 30 days (no billing) OR migrate to Starter-Hatch (reduced quota, lower price) with read-only access to indexed embeddings for 60 days. No automatic charges; customer must opt in.
Cal (AM): Legal wants the opt-in copy: short bullets, no hidden terms. I'll loop legal for a one-line approval.
Jae (Enablement): Snippet I'll use in the session: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"mini-gen","input":"hello"}'```
Rory (Support): SUP-9900 created and assigned to eng-oncall. I'll paste sample 401/429 lines and add SDK check >=2.5.0.
Mira (CSM): Feedback form (3 Qs): 1) main blocker (auth, SDK, docs, infra) 2) did session fix it? (yes/no) 3) one suggestion. paste verbatim into SUP-9900.
Ezra (CS Ops): Account flagging: "escape_hatch_active"=true start_ts=1788881234. I'll add to cohort reporting.
SkylineCo: Tue 9am PT works for pairing. Staging keys only.
Jae (Enablement): Confirmed Tue 9am PT. I'll prep the deck and async clip.
Rory (Support): Pairing slot reserved and on-call notified. adding runbook link to SUP-9900.
RevBot: Post-session probe scheduled at 1788881665 (+7h) and 1788968034 (+7d).
Mira (CSM): Action owners: Mira = outreach + opt-in copy + feedback capture; Jae = run pairing + async clip; Rory = SUP-9900 + logs; Ezra = credit ticket + account flag; Cal = AM escalation + legal loop.
Cal (AM): KPI: health >= 65 and first 3 successful calls within 5 days. If unmet, proceed with opt-in escape-hatch and schedule 1:1 renewal review.
Mira (CSM): Outreach sent. I'll paste session notes + verbatim feedback here after the meeting. Closing loop for now :white_check_mark:
